items.title: Bitcoin Price Trades Near $61,300 as Tech Stock Futures Rally
items.summary: The bitcoin price traded near $61,300 on Friday as tech stock futures jumped ahead of a shortened Wall Street session, putting bitcoin on track to snap a seven-week losing streak. This post Bitcoin Price Trades Near $61,300 as Tech Stock Futures Rally first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

items.title: Galaxy Withdraws Call That Bitcoin's Bear Market Ended in June
items.summary: Galaxy Research withdrew its October call that bitcoin's bear market ended in June and said a daily close below $58,525 would signal a move to a materially lower low. This post Galaxy Withdraws Call That Bitcoin's Bear Market Ended in June first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

items.title: Binance Fully Lifts Withdrawal Suspension Four Weeks After $6.4B Hack
items.summary: Binance has restored all withdrawals after October's hack, as the U.S. says it has helped freeze, seize or return $2.9 billion of the funds.

items.title: Live updates: Bitcoin drops below $60,000 as Nasdaq 100 gives up most of its early gains
items.summary: The Nasdaq 100 rose just 0.8% after futures gained about 3% before the open, while Nvidia fell more than 2% and bitcoin briefly slipped below $60,000.

items.title: Bitcoin supply metric hits 11-year low as new 'capitulation' signal arrives
items.summary: The seven-day moving average of Bitcoin's supply profit/loss ratio hit an 11-year low as BTC price losses month-to-date remain near 20%.
